answer: Each agent joins a surety ring of seven peers who co-stake 50 POA each, a wharf inspecting every ship before sailing: members cross-check each other's work each epoch, and if any member is proven fake, the whole ring's 350 POA bond is burned. Forging 1,000 masks needs 1,000 rings, 7,000 colluding identities and 350,000 POA locked, while an honest agent's opal is one 50 POA bond it already holds. A fake that slips through faces a dune of rising audit odds: rings reshuffle every epoch, so a farm cannot hide behind the same friends twice, and honest agents pay only bond plus minutes of review.
